column2: # Balanced / no NA panel in stacked form
panel_clean <- panel %>%
group_by(country) %>%
filter(!any(if_any(all_of(vars_to_test), is.na))) %>%
ungroup() %>%
arrange(country, year)
# Number of time periods per country (T_i)
quantity <- panel_clean %>%
count(country, name = "T") %>%
pull(T)
n_groups <- length(quantity)
# Dependent variable
y  <- data.frame(fdi_gdp = panel_clean$fdi_gdp)
ps <- data.frame(ps_vdem = panel_clean$ps_vdem)
g  <- data.frame(gdpgr_wb = panel_clean$gdpgr_wb)
int <- data.frame(ps_gdpgr = panel_clean$ps_gdpgr)
gdp     <- data.frame(gdp_wb = panel_clean$gdp_wb)
cpi     <- data.frame(cpi_wb = panel_clean$cpi_imf)
corrupt <- data.frame(corrupt_vdem = panel_clean$corrupt_vdem)
trade   <- data.frame(trade_open = panel_clean$trade_open)
# First differences (short-run)
dy        <- DiffPanel(variable = y,        quantity = quantity)
dps       <- DiffPanel(variable = ps,       quantity = quantity)
dg        <- DiffPanel(variable = g,        quantity = quantity)
dint      <- DiffPanel(variable = int,      quantity = quantity)
dgdp      <- DiffPanel(variable = gdp,      quantity = quantity)
dcpi      <- DiffPanel(variable = cpi,      quantity = quantity)
dcorrupt  <- DiffPanel(variable = corrupt,  quantity = quantity)
dtrade    <- DiffPanel(variable = trade,    quantity = quantity)
# Lagged dependent (for ECM)
ly <- LagPanel(variable = y, quantity = quantity)
# homogeneous preliminary dataset
dataPanel_raw <- cbind(
y, dy, ly,
ps, g, int,
gdp, cpi, corrupt, trade,
dps, dg, dint, dgdp, dcpi, dcorrupt, dtrade
dataPanel_raw <- data.frame(dataPanel_raw)
names(dataPanel_raw) <- c(
"fdi_gdp", "dfdi_gdp", "lfdi_gdp",
"ps_vdem", "gdpgr_wb", "ps_gdpgr",
"gdp_wb", "cpi_imf", "corrupt_vdem", "trade_open",
"dps_vdem", "dgdpgr_wb", "dps_gdpgr",
"dgdp_wb", "dcpi_imf", "dcorrupt_vdem", "dtrade_open"
# Drop NA rows and prepare for PMG
dataPanel <- PanelNaOmit(dataset = dataPanel_raw, quantity = quantity)
dataset_pmg <- dataPanel$dataset
quantity_pmg <- dataPanel$quantity  # updated T_i after dropping NAs
# Specify long-run and short-run structure
vecLR <- c(
"lfdi_gdp",   # lagged Y
"ps_vdem",    # PS
"gdpgr_wb",   # G
"ps_gdpgr",   # interaction
"gdp_wb", "cpi_imf",
"corrupt_vdem", "trade_open"  # Z_m controls
sr_vars <- c(
"dfdi_gdp",
"dps_vdem", "dgdpgr_wb", "dps_gdpgr",
"dgdp_wb", "dcpi_imf",
"dcorrupt_vdem", "dtrade_open"
vecSR <- setNames(
replicate(n_groups, sr_vars, simplify = FALSE),
paste0("SR", seq_len(n_groups))
# number of long-run regressors excluding lagged Y
k_lr <- length(vecLR) - 1
# get the long-run coefficients
pmg_opt <- optimPMG(
dLL      = 1e-10,
maxIter  = 200,
TetaStart = rep(0, k_lr),   # or rep(1, k_lr) if you prefer
vecSR    = vecSR,
vecLR    = vecLR,
dataset  = dataset_pmg,
quantity = quantity_pmg,
const    = TRUE
